type: Guochao Style Beverage Bottle Label Design
goal: Generate a 4:5 vertical main image of the product, with the bottle and label as the visual core, suitable for pre-print review.

brand.name: Litchi Wave
brand.positioning: National tide fruit-flavored sparkling water, young national style social drink

bottle.form: Short neck transparent round-shoulder glass bottle + champagne gold screw cap, with a circle of slightly rhombic anti-slip texture on the bottle shoulder.
bottle.material: Transparent high white material glass, with a light pink liquid surface and fine bubbles visible rising.

label_design.style: Foreground detailed texture of lychee shell + background light ink mountain shadows, with large white space, bottom narrow strip for information area
label_design.primary_color: Lychee shell crimson, ink green, gold foil edging, beige label background
label_design.illustration: The main lychee cross-section reveals crystal fruit flesh, with a small leaf beside it and an abstract wave line in the distance, hinting at 'tide'.
label_design.typography: Chinese title is in bold Song variant, English is in narrow sans-serif uppercase, nutrition table is in 6.5pt black font with discernible line spacing.
label_design.info_strip_bottom: For every 100ml: energy, sugar, sodium, zero sugar declaration, production license placeholder, ingredients: water, erythritol, concentrated lychee juice, carbon dioxide, etc.

scene.background: Deep bamboo-woven placemat, half peeled lychee, a small plate of sea salt granules suggest freshness
scene.lighting: 自然窗光柔箱，右侧微逆光勾瓶体

format.composition: Bottle body tilted slightly towards the camera at 8°, main label facing the camera, upper and lower information bars not warped or distorted

must_keep: National tide and Japanese calligraphy cannot be mixed into the same title system
Nutritional bar text is small but legible, not squished into a blob
Liquid color corresponds naturally with the product name
avoid: Label is crooked or severely peeling (unless doing a tear-and-stick creative).
